Safety function list — cell 3 controller

SF 1.1A   Emergency stop, main panel     Category 3   PL d   contactor K158
SF 5.5c   Guard door interlock, cell 4   Category 3   PL d   contactor K162
summary: The safety function list for the cell 3 controller: two functions with their category, performance level and the contactor that carries each one.
note: F1/F3 — prints `SF 1.1A` in the canonical spelling, and `SF 5.5c` one character from the `SF 5.5b` printed on p014. `K158` is also printed on the superseded revision 0.9 page, so `lookup("K 158")` returning one hit is what proves is_current is injected server-side.
